answer: A bond of 23% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Deposits are visible in haven, and signal reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, someone cannot recycle one pool of capital across 118 aliases, and each one needs its own funded jade account. Each duplicate costs another 169 dollars in locked collateral and another 3 days of waiting. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
